text:
Emma (Partnerships): Hi team — Nimbus sent updated partner assets for the EMEA launch. Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNIMBUS_localized
Emma (Partnerships): They included: new logo pack (multicolor + mono), localized case study translations (EN/FR/DE), and a solution brief in English + French.
Raj (Marketing): Quick ask — do we have brand alignment on the headline copy? Nimbus' brief uses 'enterprise-grade inference' but our copy usually uses 'production-grade inference'. Small but matters for co-branded ctAs.
Mike (Design): Downloading logos now. Files look ok but several PNGs only. We need SVG/EPS for print and marketplace banners. Can we ask them for vector files?
Emma (Partnerships): Good catch. I'll request vectors. @Olivia, can you confirm Nimbus can share EPS/SVG and color hex values?
Olivia (Partner PM): On it. Pinged their PM (Aisha) and asked for SVG/EPS + official color tokens and full logo usage guide. ETA today EOD GMT.
nimbus-upload-bot: file uploaded: /assets/nimbus_logo_pack_v3.zip
Mike (Design): Got the zip — looks like 2 SVGs but the mono variant is missing. Also spacing rules absent. I'll draft a quick sample usage sheet for Legal to review.
Sarah (Legal): Heads up: translated case studies reference customer names and a quote that mentions GDPR-compliant prompts. Need to confirm Nimbus has customer permission for translations and the quotes. Also check for any localized data residency claims (DE/FR) — we should avoid implied hosting guarantees in co-branded copy.
Liang (Solutions): For the solution brief: the architecture diagram includes a labeled 'Redwood Dedicated' box but the fonts are different and the callout positions overlap in FR layout. We should standardize copy blocks so the marketplace listing screenshot looks clean.
Raj (Marketing): Suggestion: keep headline copy to our canonical phrasing: 'production-grade inference'. If Nimbus insists on 'enterprise-grade' maybe we add a parenthesis note. But prefer to push for consistent messaging.
Emma (Partnerships): Agreed. I'll propose the canonical headline and two options for subhead. Also note we need final approved copy for cloud marketplace listing — sync with marketplace PM.
Olivia (Partner PM): Nimbus replied: they can provide mono SVG + spacing spec, but need our logo usage guidelines in return. I attached our partner logo guide: https://redwood.co/brand/partner-logo-guidelines.pdf
Mike (Design): Thanks. I'll align their spacing spec to our guide and produce an EPS with proper clearspace. Uploading draft in a minute.
nimbus-upload-bot: file uploaded: /assets/redwood_nimbus_co-brand_sheet_v1.pdf
Sarah (Legal): After Mike's draft, Legal will run a quick review. Main checks: 1) no implied SLAs in the case study 2) permissions for translated quotes 3) logo usage doesn't imply joint ownership. If any claim about data residency remains, we request removal or a clarifying footnote.
Emma (Partnerships): Checklist for us (quick):\n```
- request SVG/EPS + color tokens from Nimbus (Olivia)
- confirm translated quote permissions (Sarah)
- align headline copy to 'production-grade inference' (Raj)
- create co-brand usage PDF (Mike)
- final marketing brief for marketplace (Emma/Raj)
- legal signoff documented (Sarah)
```
Liang (Solutions): Also flag the architecture diagram for the marketplace thumbnail — reduce text and increase white space. I can mock a compact version for their screenshot.
Raj (Marketing): Timeline ask: marketplace listing drops next Wednesday. Can we get all assets + legal signoff by Monday EOD to hit handoff Tuesday?
Olivia (Partner PM): Nimbus confirmed they can hit Monday AM for vectors and translation permission docs. Pushing them for earlier if possible.
Mike (Design): Draft co-brand PDF uploaded: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xyz_co-brand-draft.pdf — please review layout and spacing.
Sarah (Legal): Reviewing Mike's draft now. Will flag anything that needs edits inline in the PDF comments.
Emma (Partnerships): Perfect. If Legal gives green by Monday afternoon, we can queue the marketplace PR with product and marketplace PM. I'll update this thread as items land. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
Raj (Marketing): Thanks — assign me to finalize the marketplace copy once legal clears.
Mike (Design): noted :paintbrush:
Sarah (Legal): added comments — one content ask on p.3 where Nimbus uses 'hosted in EU'. Suggest change to 'available in EU regions' or remove.
Olivia (Partner PM): Nimbus acknowledged legal note and said they'll remove the phrase. They'll upload corrected FR/DE case studies by tomorrow.
Emma (Partnerships): Closing loop: next update 1824000600 when assets arrive or sooner. If anything blocks earlier, ping me directly. :eyes:
